title: We want to cover your AI bill while you make games. We’re sponsoring Codex subscriptions for game devs who publish through our MCP.
author: cody-fifth-door
selftext:
Hey everyone!   
  
I'm Cody, I am a real human and game dev. You may have seen a couple of my posts on here for the voxel colony builder I'm working on, Cubescape.  Just to say, this is not a bot post.  
  
I also work on [Fifth Door](https://fifthdoor.com/), a platform for creating and publishing games. You can build games in our session editor, or build with tools like Codex and publish them on Fifth Door through our MCP. We’re launching a small sponsorship program for developers interested in that second workflow.

**We’ll cover one month of your Codex subscription. In exchange, you build and publish at least one playable game on Fifth Door through our MCP and give us honest feedback.**

Our goal is straightforward: get more people making games on Fifth Door and learn where our tools work well and where they get in your way.

You can check out our [MCP documentation here](https://play.fifthdoor.com/docs/mcp).

**What we’re asking for:**

* Publish a playable game through our MCP within 30 days of starting the sponsorship. Keep the scope manageable. A small, fun game is a great place to start.
* Do one short midway check-in and share a final recap of your experience.
* Tell us what broke, what was confusing, and what you wish the tools could do.

If a bug or limitation on our side blocks your release, we’ll work with you and adjust the timeline.

We’re selecting developers based on what they’ve built before and what they want to make next. Additional sponsored months may be available based on progress and useful feedback.

**Interested?** Comment or DM me with:

* A playable link, gameplay clip, or repo from something you’ve built.
* A few sentences about the game you’d like to make.

We’ll review submissions and follow up with developers who look like a good fit. Happy to answer questions here!
